    p.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True); return p

def _log_uncaught(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb):
    try: ERRLOG.write_text(''.join(traceback.format_exception(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)), encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception: pass
    try: sys.__excepthook__(exc_type, exc_value, exc_tb)
    except Exception: pass
sys.excepthook=_log_uncaught
def loadj(p,d):
    try: return json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')) if p.exists() else d
    except Exception: return d
def savej(p,d):
    try: p.write_text(json.dumps(d,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception: pass
def btn(t,w=None,bg='white',fg='#111',h=27):
    b=QPushButton(t); b.setFixedHeight(h); b.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
    if w: b.setFixedWidth(w)
    b.setStyleSheet(f'QPushButton{{background:{bg};color:{fg};border:1px solid {BORDER};border-radius:5px;padding:1px 4px;font-weight:600;}}QPushButton:hover{{background:#eef7ee;}}')
    return b
def norm_url(t):
    t=(t or '').strip()
    if not t: return 'about:blank'
    if t.startswith(('http://','https://','file://','about:')): return t
    if re.match(r'^[\w.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}',t): return 'https://'+t
    return 'https://www.google.com/search?q='+quote(t)
def strip_html(s):
    s=s or ''
    s=re.sub(r'(?is)<(script|style).*?>.*?</\1>',' ',s)
    s=re.sub(r'(?is)<[^>]+>',' ',s)
    s=re.sub(r'&nbsp;',' ',s); s=re.sub(r'&amp;','&',s); s=re.sub(r'&lt;','<',s); s=re.sub(r'&gt;','>',s)
    return re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',s).strip()
def kata_full(s):
    out=[]; buf=''
    for ch in s or '':
        if '\uff61' <= ch <= '\uff9f': buf+=ch
        else:
            if buf: out.append(unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',buf)); buf=''
            out.append(ch)
    if buf: out.append(unicodedata.normalize('NFKC',buf))
    return ''.join(out)
def lines(t): return [x.strip() for x in strip_html(t).splitlines() if x.strip()]
def after(t,k):
    ls=lines(t)
    for i,x in enumerate(ls):
        if x.lower()==k.lower() and i+1<len(ls): return ls[i+1]
    # key:value variants
    pat=r'(?im)^\s*'+re.escape(k)+r'\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(.+)$'
    m=re.search(pat,strip_html(t))
    return m.group(1).strip() if m else ''
def regex_first(t, patterns):
    st=strip_html(t)
    for pat in patterns:
        m=re.search(pat,st,re.I|re.M)
        if m: return m.group(1).strip()
    return ''
def tag_of(t):
    v=regex_first(t,[r'[￭■\-\*\s]*(?:Tag|TAG|タグ|サービスタグ|Sタグ|Service\s*Tag)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*([A-Z0-9]{5,10})\b'])
    if v: return v.upper()
    a=after(t,'Asset')
    return a.upper() if re.match(r'^[A-Z0-9]{5,10}$',a or '') and re.search(r'\d',a) else ''
def case_of(t):
    v=regex_first(t,[r'[￭■\-\*\s]*(?:CASE|Case|ケース)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(\d{6,})\b'])
    if v: return v
    m=re.search(r'(?im)^\s*Case\s*$\s*(\d{6,})\b',strip_html(t))
    if m: return m.group(1)
    v=after(t,'Case') or after(t,'Case Number')
    return v if re.search(r'\d',v or '') else ''
def product_of(t):
    return (regex_first(t,[r'(?:機種名|機種|model|Model)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(.+)$']) or after(t,'Product Description')).strip()
def phenomenon_of(t):
    return (regex_first(t,[r'(?:現象|症状)\s*[#＃:：]?\s*(.+)$']) or after(t,'Case Description')).strip()
def account_of(t): return after(t,'Account Name')
def merge_info(primary, secondary=''):
    p={'tag':tag_of(primary),'case':case_of(primary),'product':product_of(primary),'phenomenon':phenomenon_of(primary),'account':account_of(primary)}
    s={'tag':tag_of(secondary),'case':case_of(secondary),'product':product_of(secondary),'phenomenon':phenomenon_of(secondary),'account':account_of(secondary)}
    return {k:(p.get(k) or s.get(k) or '') for k in p}
def mask(t):
    t=strip_html(t)
    for p,r in [(r'[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}','[EMAIL]'),(r'https?://[^\s]+','[URL]')]: t=re.sub(p,r,t,flags=re.I)
    return t
def subject(i): return kata_full('[CTE ESC]TAG#%s/CASE#%s/機種:%s/現象:%s/顧客名:%s様'%((i.get('tag') or '未検出'),(i.get('case') or '未検出'),(i.get('product') or '未検出'),(i.get('phenomenon') or '未検出'),(i.get('account') or '未検出')))
def memo_min(i): return '\n'.join(['■TAG#%s'%(i.get('tag') or '未検出'),'■CASE#%s'%(i.get('case') or '未検出'),'■機種：%s'%(i.get('product') or '未検出')])
def tag_display_text(n):
    if not isinstance(n,dict): return ''
    tag=(n.get('tag') or '').strip()
    if tag: return tag
    info=merge_info(n.get('raw',''),n.get('content',''))
    return (info.get('tag') or '').strip()

def normalize_tag_text(raw):
    raw=strip_html(raw or '').strip()
    v=tag_of(raw)
    if v: return v
    # 直接TAGだけを入力した場合は保持。それ以外の文章はTAG欄へ表示しない。
    return raw.upper() if re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9]{5,10}', raw) and re.search(r'\d', raw) else ''
def tag_color_index(n):
    try:
        return n.get('fixed_index',n.get('color',0)) if is_fixed(n) else n.get('color',0)
    except Exception:
        return 0

def lkb(t):
    m=re.search(r'(?i)LKB[#\s-]*(\d+)',strip_html(t))
    return 'LKB#'+m.group(1) if m else ''
def rec_prompt(raw,i):
    return '\n'.join(['以下のメモ内容からRECエスカレーション用の内容だけを作成してください。','下記形式を必ず維持してください。余計な見出しや「REC Chat用」は不要です。','個人情報は含めないでください。','','■TAG#%s'%(i.get('tag') or '未検出'),'■CASE#%s'%(i.get('case') or '未検出'),'■機種：%s'%(i.get('product') or '未検出'),'■Ask:RECへのエスカレーション内容要約(RECがどうSupportできるか伺い)','■KBキーワード:%s'%lkb(raw),'■DTC Keywords:','■Summary:問題についての明確な説明','','■理由/背景：あれば（お客様背景や●台中●台の問題などAIが自動入力）','■OS情報：あれば（できる限り詳細を記載）','■いつから：あれば','■頻度：あれば','■その他情報：あれば（ログ解析結果やエスカレーションで必要な内容）','','--- メモ内容 ---',mask(raw)])
def build_prompt(name,raw,prompts,tag):
    if 'REC' in name: return rec_prompt(raw,merge_info(raw))
    return 'これは現在選択中のメモ専用Caseです。他Caseや過去会話は参照しないでください。\nService Tag: '+(tag or '未検出')+'\n\n'+prompts.get(name,PROMPTS.get(name,''))+'\n\n--- 入力内容 ---\n'+mask(raw)
class PlainTextEdit(QTextEdit):
    def insertFromMimeData(self, source):
        self.insertPlainText(source.text())

_KNOWLEDGE_B64=""
_DELL_NS=None; _DELL_CLASS=None
def load_embedded_dell_sites_tab():
    global _DELL_NS,_DELL_CLASS
    if _DELL_CLASS is not None: return _DELL_CLASS
    ns={'__name__':'embedded_knowledge_dell_sites'}
    exec(compile(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(_KNOWLEDGE_B64)).decode('utf-8'),'embedded_knowledge.txt','exec'),ns)
    _DELL_NS=ns; _DELL_CLASS=ns.get('DellSitesTab'); return _DELL_CLASS
class FloatingOpenButton(QPushButton):
    def __init__(self,parent,overlay):
        super().__init__('DELL開く',parent); self.overlay=overlay
        self.setFixedSize(86,28)
        self.setStyleSheet('QPushButton{background:#dbeafe;border:1px solid #60a5fa;border-radius:7px;font-weight:700;}QPushButton:hover{background:#bfdbfe;}')
        self.clicked.connect(self.overlay.restore_overlay)
    def place(self):
        p=self.parentWidget().rect(); self.move(max(0,p.width()-95),28); self.raise_()
class FloatingDellOverlay(QFrame):
    HANDLE_W=6
    def __init__(self,parent,settings):
        super().__init__(parent); self.settings=settings; self.resizing=False; self.start_x=0; self.start_w=0
        self.settings['dell_overlay_minimized']=False
        self.setFrameShape(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame); self.setStyleSheet('QFrame{background:white;border-left:1px solid #cbd5e1;}')
        lay=QVBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(self.HANDLE_W,0,0,0); lay.setSpacing(0)
        self.head=QWidget(); self.head.setStyleSheet('background:#f8fafc;border-bottom:1px solid #cbd5e1;')
        hl=QHBoxLayout(self.head); hl.setContentsMargins(6,2,6,2)
        self.title=QLabel('DELLサイトなど'); self.minbtn=QPushButton('－'); self.minbtn.setFixedSize(28,22)
        hl.addWidget(self.title); hl.addStretch(); hl.addWidget(self.minbtn); lay.addWidget(self.head,0)
        try: self.dell=load_embedded_dell_sites_tab()(self)
        except Exception as e: self.dell=QLabel('DellSitesTab読込エラー: '+str(e)); self.dell.setWordWrap(True)
        lay.addWidget(self.dell,1)
        self.handle=QFrame(self); self.handle.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.SizeHorCursor); self.handle.setStyleSheet('background:#9ca3af; border-right:1px solid #64748b;')
        self.handle.mousePressEvent=self.handle_press; self.handle.mouseMoveEvent=self.handle_move; self.handle.mouseReleaseEvent=self.handle_release
        self.close_btn=QPushButton('閉じる'); self.close_btn.setFixedSize(48,24)
        self.close_btn.setStyleSheet('QPushButton{background:#fee2e2;border:1px solid #fca5a5;border-radius:5px;font-weight:600;}')
        self.close_btn.clicked.connect(self.minimize); self.minbtn.clicked.connect(self.minimize)
        self.open_btn=FloatingOpenButton(parent,self); self.open_btn.hide()
        if 'dell_overlay_width' not in self.settings: self.settings['dell_overlay_width']=760
        QTimer.singleShot(0,self.setup_close_button); QTimer.singleShot(0,self.apply_dock_geometry)
    def setup_close_button(self):
        try:
            b=getattr(self.dell,'back_button',None)
            if b and b.parentWidget() and b.parentWidget().layout(): b.parentWidget().layout().insertWidget(0,self.close_btn,0)
            else: self.close_btn.setParent(self.head); self.head.layout().insertWidget(0,self.close_btn,0)
        except Exception: self.close_btn.setParent(self.head); self.head.layout().insertWidget(0,self.close_btn,0)
    def apply_dock_geometry(self):
        p=self.parentWidget().rect(); self.open_btn.place()
        if self.settings.get('dell_overlay_minimized'): return
        w=max(420,min(int(self.settings.get('dell_overlay_width',760)),p.width()-80))
        self.setGeometry(p.width()-w,0,w,p.height()); self.handle.setGeometry(0,0,self.HANDLE_W,self.height()); self.handle.raise_(); self.raise_()
    def handle_press(self,e):
        if e.button()==Qt.MouseButton.LeftButton: self.resizing=True; self.start_x=e.globalPosition().toPoint().x(); self.start_w=self.width(); e.accept()
    def handle_move(self,e):
        if self.resizing:
            dx=self.start_x-e.globalPosition().toPoint().x(); p=self.parentWidget().rect(); w=max(420,min(self.start_w+dx,p.width()-80)); self.settings['dell_overlay_width']=w; self.apply_dock_geometry(); e.accept()
    def handle_release(self,e): self.resizing=False
    def minimize(self):
        self.settings['dell_overlay_minimized']=True; self.settings['dell_overlay_width']=max(self.width(),420); self.hide(); self.open_btn.show(); self.open_btn.place()
    def restore_overlay(self):
        self.settings['dell_overlay_minimized']=False; self.open_btn.hide(); self.show(); self.apply_dock_geometry()
    def set_tag_for_group(self,idx,tag):
        try:
            if hasattr(self.dell,'tag_boxes') and 0<=idx<len(self.dell.tag_boxes):
                box=self.dell.tag_boxes[idx]
                if box.text()!=tag: box.setText(tag or '')
                # tag only sync: do not auto-open
        except Exception: pass
class Page(QWebEnginePage if WEB else object):
    if WEB:
        def __init__(self,profile,browser=None,parent=None): super().__init__(profile,parent); self.browser=browser
        def createWindow(self,_):
            try:
                v=self.browser.add_tab('about:blank', switch=True)
                return v.page()
            except Exception:
                return self
class Browser(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self,s):
        super().__init__(); self.s=s; self.setWindowTitle('Google Browser'); self.bookmarks=s.get('browser_bookmarks',[])
        c=QWidget(); self.setCentralWidget(c); l=QVBoxLayout(c); l.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0); l.setSpacing(0)
        r=QHBoxLayout(); r.setContentsMargins(4,2,4,2); r.setSpacing(4); l.addLayout(r)
        self.back=btn('←',34); self.fwd=btn('→',34); self.reload=btn('更新',46); self.home=btn('Home',48)
        self.addr=QLineEdit(); self.addr.setFixedHeight(28); self.star=btn('☆',34); self.plus=btn('＋',34); self.ext=btn('外部',48)
        for w in (self.back,self.fwd,self.reload,self.home,self.addr,self.star,self.plus,self.ext): r.addWidget(w)
        self.bookbar=QWidget(); bl=QHBoxLayout(self.bookbar); bl.setContentsMargins(4,2,4,2); bl.setSpacing(4); l.addWidget(self.bookbar)
        self.tabs=QTabWidget(); self.tabs.setTabsClosable(True); self.tabs.setMovable(True); l.addWidget(self.tabs,1)
        if WEB:
            self.prof=QWebEngineProfile('GoogleProfile',self); self.prof.setPersistentStoragePath(str(appdir()/'GoogleProfile')); self.prof.setCachePath(str(appdir()/'GoogleCache')); self.prof.setPersistentCookiesPolicy(QWebEngineProfile.PersistentCookiesPolicy.ForcePersistentCookies); self.prof.setHttpUserAgent(UA)
            try:
                self.prof.settings().setAttribute(QWebEngineSettings.WebAttribute.JavascriptCanOpenWindows, True)
                self.prof.settings().setAttribute(QWebEngineSettings.WebAttribute.LocalStorageEnabled, True)
            except Exception: pass
        self.add_tab(s.get('google_last',GOOGLE)); self.render_bookmarks(); self.dell_overlay=FloatingDellOverlay(c,self.s); self.dell_overlay.raise_()
        self.addr.returnPressed.connect(lambda:self.cur().setUrl(QUrl(norm_url(self.addr.text()))) if self.cur() else None)
        self.plus.clicked.connect(lambda:self.add_tab(GOOGLE)); self.ext.clicked.connect(lambda:webbrowser.open(self.addr.text() or GOOGLE))
        self.back.clicked.connect(lambda:self.cur().back() if self.cur() else None); self.fwd.clicked.connect(lambda:self.cur().forward() if self.cur() else None); self.reload.clicked.connect(lambda:self.cur().reload() if self.cur() else None); self.home.clicked.connect(lambda:self.cur().setUrl(QUrl(GOOGLE)) if self.cur() else None)
        self.star.clicked.connect(self.add_bookmark); self.tabs.tabCloseRequested.connect(self.close_tab)
        QShortcut(QKeySequence('Ctrl+L'),self,activated=lambda:(self.addr.setFocus(),self.addr.selectAll()))
        QShortcut(QKeySequence('Ctrl+T'),self,activated=lambda:self.add_tab(GOOGLE))
        QShortcut(QKeySequence('Ctrl+W'),self,activated=lambda:self.close_tab(self.tabs.currentIndex()))
        QShortcut(QKeySequence('F5'),self,activated=lambda:self.cur().reload() if self.cur() else None)
    def resizeEvent(self,e):
        super().resizeEvent(e)
        try:
            if getattr(self,'dell_overlay',None): self.dell_overlay.apply_dock_geometry()
        except Exception: pass
    def cur(self):
        w=self.tabs.currentWidget(); return w if WEB and isinstance(w,QWebEngineView) else None
    def add_tab(self,u,switch=True):
        if WEB:
            v=QWebEngineView(); v.setPage(Page(self.prof,self,v)); v.setUrl(QUrl(norm_url(u))); v.urlChanged.connect(lambda url,v=v:self.on_url(v,url)); v.titleChanged.connect(lambda title,v=v:self.on_title(v,title)); v.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu); v.customContextMenuRequested.connect(lambda pos,v=v:self.web_context_menu(v,pos))
        else: v=QLabel('WebEngineなし')
        self.tabs.addTab(v,'New')
        if switch: self.tabs.setCurrentWidget(v)
        self.addr.setText(norm_url(u)); return v
    def on_url(self,v,url):
        if self.cur() is v: self.addr.setText(url.toString())
    def on_title(self,v,title):
        idx=self.tabs.indexOf(v)
        if idx>=0: self.tabs.setTabText(idx,(title or 'New')[:22])
    def close_tab(self,idx):
        if self.tabs.count()<=1: return
        w=self.tabs.widget(idx); self.tabs.removeTab(idx); w.deleteLater()
    def render_bookmarks(self):
        layout=self.bookbar.layout()
        while layout.count():
            item=layout.takeAt(0); w=item.widget(); w.deleteLater() if w else None
        for bm in self.bookmarks[:12]:
            b=btn(bm.get('title','BM')[:14]); b.clicked.connect(lambda _,u=bm.get('url',GOOGLE): self.add_tab(u)); layout.addWidget(b)
        layout.addStretch()
    def add_bookmark(self):
        url=self.addr.text().strip() or GOOGLE; title=self.tabs.tabText(self.tabs.currentIndex()) or 'Bookmark'; self.bookmarks.append({'title':title[:18],'url':url}); self.s['browser_bookmarks']=self.bookmarks; self.render_bookmarks()
    def web_context_menu(self,v,pos):
        m=QMenu(self); m.addAction('戻る',v.back); m.addAction('進む',v.forward); m.addAction('更新',v.reload); m.addSeparator(); m.addAction('現在URLをコピー',lambda:QApplication.clipboard().setText(v.url().toString())); m.addAction('外部ブラウザで開く',lambda:webbrowser.open(v.url().toString())); m.exec(v.mapToGlobal(pos))
    def save(self,s): s['google_last']=self.addr.text(); s['browser_bookmarks']=self.bookmarks; g=self.geometry(); s['google_geo']=[g.x(),g.y(),g.width(),g.height()]

class AskColorTabBar(QTabBar):
    COLORS=TAG_TAB_COLORS
    SELECT=['#93c5fd','#fde68a','#f9a8d4','#c4b5fd']
    def tabSizeHint(self,i):
        s=super().tabSizeHint(i); s.setWidth(max(74,s.width()+12)); s.setHeight(max(30,s.height()+4)); return s
    def paintEvent(self,e):
        p=QPainter(self); p.setRenderHint(QPainter.RenderHint.Antialiasing)
        for i in range(self.count()):
            r=self.tabRect(i).adjusted(2,4,-2,-2)
            p.setPen(QColor('#94a3b8'))
            base = (self.COLORS[i] if i < 4 else '#ffffff')
            sel = (self.SELECT[i] if i < 4 else SELECTED_BLUE)
            p.setBrush(QColor(sel if i==self.currentIndex() else base))
            p.drawRoundedRect(r,7,7)
            p.setPen(QColor('#ffffff' if i==self.currentIndex() and i>=4 else '#111827'))
            p.drawText(r,Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter,self.tabText(i))
class AskTabs(QWidget):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(); self.map={}; self.slot_id=[None]*4; self.slot_view=[None]*4; self.last=''
        l=QVBoxLayout(self); l.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0)
        top=QHBoxLayout(); self.reload=btn('Ask更新',70); self.clear=btn('入力クリア',76,bg=RED); top.addWidget(self.reload); top.addWidget(self.clear); top.addStretch(); l.addLayout(top)
        self.tabs=QTabWidget(); self.tabs.setTabBar(AskColorTabBar()); l.addWidget(self.tabs)
        if WEB:
            self.prof=QWebEngineProfile('AskProfile',self); self.prof.setPersistentStoragePath(str(appdir()/'AskProfile')); self.prof.setCachePath(str(appdir()/'AskCache')); self.prof.setPersistentCookiesPolicy(QWebEngineProfile.PersistentCookiesPolicy.ForcePersistentCookies); self.prof.setHttpUserAgent(UA)
        self.reload.clicked.connect(self.reload_current); self.clear.clicked.connect(self.clear_input)
    def slot(self,n):
        try: return max(0,min(3,int(n.get('fixed_index',0))))
        except Exception: return 0
    def title(self,n): return FIXED_TAG_TITLES[self.slot(n)]
    def ensure(self,n):
        i=self.slot(n); nid=n['id']
        if self.slot_id[i]==nid and self.slot_view[i] is not None:
            v=self.slot_view[i]
            idx=self.tabs.indexOf(v)
            if idx>=0: self.tabs.setTabText(idx,self.title(n))
            return v
        old=self.slot_view[i]
        if old is not None:
            old_idx=self.tabs.indexOf(old)
            if old_idx>=0: self.tabs.removeTab(old_idx)
            self.map.pop(self.slot_id[i],None)
            old.deleteLater()
        if WEB:
            v=QWebEngineView(); v.setPage(Page(self.prof,None,v)); v.setZoomFactor(.8); v.setUrl(QUrl(ASK))
        else: v=QLabel('WebEngineなし')
        self.slot_id[i]=nid; self.slot_view[i]=v; self.map[nid]=v
        self.tabs.insertTab(i,v,self.title(n))
        return v
    def switch(self,n):
        v=self.ensure(n); idx=self.tabs.indexOf(v)
        if idx>=0: self.tabs.setCurrentIndex(idx)
    def reload_current(self):
        v=self.tabs.currentWidget()
        if WEB and isinstance(v,QWebEngineView): v.reload()
    def clear_input(self):
        v=self.tabs.currentWidget()
        if WEB and isinstance(v,QWebEngineView): v.page().runJavaScript("document.querySelectorAll('textarea,div[contenteditable=\\\"true\\\"],[role=\\\"textbox\\\"],input[type=\\\"text\\\"]').forEach(e=>{if(['TEXTAREA','INPUT'].includes(e.tagName))e.value='';else e.textContent='';e.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true}));});")
    def delete_tab(self,nid):
        if nid not in self.map: return
        v=self.map.pop(nid)
        idx_slot=next((i for i,x in enumerate(self.slot_id) if x==nid),-1)
        if idx_slot>=0: self.slot_id[idx_slot]=None; self.slot_view[idx_slot]=None
        idx=self.tabs.indexOf(v)
        if idx>=0: self.tabs.removeTab(idx)
        v.deleteLater()
    def set_prompt(self,t): self.last=t; QApplication.clipboard().setText(t)
    def send(self,enter=True):
        v=self.tabs.currentWidget()
        if not (WEB and isinstance(v,QWebEngineView)): return
        text=self.last or QApplication.clipboard().text(); QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
        ent="setTimeout(()=>{el.focus();el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',keyCode:13,which:13,bubbles:true}));el.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup',{key:'Enter',code:'Enter',keyCode:13,which:13,bubbles:true}));},300);" if enter else ''
        js="(()=>{const text="+json.dumps(text)+";const n=[...document.querySelectorAll('textarea,div[contenteditable=\\\"true\\\"],[role=\\\"textbox\\\"],input[type=\\\"text\\\"]')];const el=n[0];if(!el)return false;el.focus();if(['TEXTAREA','INPUT'].includes(el.tagName)){el.value=text;el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,data:text}));}else{el.textContent=text;el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,data:text}));}"+ent+"return true;})();"
        v.page().runJavaScript(js)

    def restart_app(self): self.save_state(self.s); savej(SET,self.s); QProcess.startDetached(sys.executable,[str(Path(__file__).resolve())]); QApplication.quit()
    def new(self): return {'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'title':'メモ%d'%(len(self.notes)+1),'content':'','raw':'','tag':'','color':len(self.notes)%len(COLORS)}
    def current_prompt(self):
        it=self.plist.currentItem() or self.plist.item(0); return it.text() if it else '🔎 汎用分析'
    def load(self):
        d=loadj(MEMO,{}); self.notes=d.get('notes',[]) if isinstance(d,dict) else []
        if not self.notes: self.notes=[self.new()]
        for i,n in enumerate(self.notes): n.setdefault('id',str(uuid.uuid4())); n.setdefault('title','メモ%d'%(i+1)); n.setdefault('content',''); n.setdefault('raw',''); n.setdefault('tag',tag_of(n.get('raw',''))); n.setdefault('color',i%len(COLORS))
        self.idx=max(0,min(d.get('idx',0) if isinstance(d,dict) else 0,len(self.notes)-1)); self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.apply(); [self.ask.ensure(n) for n in self.notes]
    def save(self): self.sync(); savej(MEMO,{'notes':self.notes,'idx':self.idx}); self.s['prompt_order']=[self.plist.item(i).text() for i in range(self.plist.count())]; self.s['split_sizes']=self.split.sizes()
    def refresh(self):
        self.list.blockSignals(True); self.list.clear()
        for n in self.notes:
            it=QListWidgetItem(); it.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole,n['id']); it.setSizeHint(QSize(132,58)); self.list.addItem(it); w=NoteItem(n); w.raw_changed.connect(lambda raw,nid=n['id']:self.related_changed(nid,raw)); w.delete.connect(lambda nid=n['id']:self.delete(nid)); self.list.setItemWidget(it,w)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)
        try:
            for _si,_sn in enumerate(self.notes[:4]):
                self.sync_tag_to_dell(_si,_sn.get('tag',''))
        except Exception: pass
    def sync(self):
        if 0<=self.idx<len(self.notes): self.notes[self.idx]['content']=strip_html(self.edit.toPlainText())
    def cur_info(self):
        if not (0<=self.idx<len(self.notes)): return merge_info('','')
        n=self.notes[self.idx]; return merge_info(n.get('raw',''), self.edit.toPlainText())
    def update_outputs(self):
        i=self.cur_info(); self.sub.setText(subject(i)); self.mx.setPlainText(memo_min(i))
    def apply(self): self.edit.blockSignals(True); self.edit.setPlainText(strip_html(self.notes[self.idx].get('content',''))); self.edit.blockSignals(False); self.ask.switch(self.notes[self.idx]); self.update_outputs()
    def related_changed(self,nid,raw):
        for i,n in enumerate(self.notes):
            if n['id']==nid:
                cleaned=strip_html(raw)
                n['raw']=cleaned
                info=merge_info(cleaned,n.get('content',''))
                if info.get('tag'): n['tag']=info.get('tag','')
                n['title']=FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i] if i<4 else (info.get('tag') or n.get('title') or 'メモ')
                try: self.sync_tag_to_dell(i,n.get('tag',''))
                except Exception: pass
                if i==self.idx:
                    try: self.apply()
                    except Exception: self.update_outputs()
                break
        self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.save()
    def change(self,row): self.sync(); self.idx=row if 0<=row<len(self.notes) else self.idx; self.apply(); self.save()
    def text_change(self): self.sync(); self.update_outputs(); self.save()
    def add_note(self):
        self.sync(); n=self.new(); self.notes.append(n); self.idx=len(self.notes)-1; self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.edit.clear(); self.apply(); self.ask.ensure(n); self.save()
    def delete(self,nid):
        if len(self.notes)==1: self.notes[0].update({'title':'メモ1','content':'','raw':'','tag':''}); self.idx=0
        else: self.notes=[n for n in self.notes if n['id']!=nid]; self.ask.delete_tab(nid); self.idx=max(0,min(self.idx,len(self.notes)-1))
        self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.apply(); self.save()
    def to_ask(self,enter): self.sync(); n=self.notes[self.idx]; self.ask.switch(n); source=(n.get('raw','')+'\n'+self.edit.toPlainText()).strip(); self.ask.set_prompt(build_prompt(self.current_prompt(),source,self.prompts,n.get('tag',''))); self.ask.send(enter)
    def save_state(self,s): self.save(); g=self.geometry(); s['app_geo']=[g.x(),g.y(),g.width(),g.height()]

def tool_ns():
    global _TOOL_NS
    if _TOOL_NS is not None: return _TOOL_NS
    ns={'__name__':'embedded_business_tools_latest'}
    try: exec(compile(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(_KNOWLEDGE_B64)).decode('utf-8'),'embedded_business_tools_latest.txt','exec'),ns)

def configure_web_profile(prof, name='SharedSSOProfile'):
    if not (WEB and prof): return prof
    try:
        base=appdir()/name
        prof.setPersistentStoragePath(str(base))
        prof.setCachePath(str(appdir()/(name+'Cache')))
    except Exception: pass
    try: prof.setPersistentCookiesPolicy(QWebEngineProfile.PersistentCookiesPolicy.ForcePersistentCookies)
    except Exception: pass
    try: prof.setHttpUserAgent(UA)
    except Exception: pass
    try: prof.setHttpAcceptLanguage('ja-JP,ja;q=0.9,en-US;q=0.8,en;q=0.7')
    except Exception: pass
    return prof
def is_fixed(n): return isinstance(n.get('fixed_index'),int) and 0<=n.get('fixed_index')<=3
def ntitle(n):
    t=(n.get('tag') or '').strip()
    if t: return t[:18]
    return FIXED_TAG_TITLES[n['fixed_index']] if is_fixed(n) else (n.get('title') or 'メモ')[:18]
def fixed_note(i, old=None):
    old=old or {}; raw=str(old.get('raw','') or '')
    return {'id':str(old.get('id') or uuid.uuid4()),'title':FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i],'content':str(old.get('content','') or ''),'raw':raw,'tag':tag_of(raw),'color':i,'fixed_index':i}
def extra_note(notes):
    names=[n.get('title','') for n in notes]; i=1
    while f'メモ{i}' in names: i+=1
    return {'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'title':f'メモ{i}','content':'','raw':'','tag':'','color':len(notes)%len(COLORS)}

def cleanup_req_path(): return appdir()/'restart_cleanup_request.json'
def req_cleanup(mode):
    try: cleanup_req_path().write_text(json.dumps({'mode':mode},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    except Exception: pass
def perform_cleanup():
    try:
        p=cleanup_req_path()
        if not p.exists(): return
        m=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8')).get('mode')
        import shutil
        targets=[]
        if m in ('dell_cache','dell_sso'): targets.append(appdir()/'DellSitesCache')
        if m=='dell_sso': targets.append(appdir()/'DellSitesProfile')
        for t in targets:
            if t.exists(): shutil.rmtree(t,ignore_errors=True)
        p.unlink(missing_ok=True)
    except Exception: pass
def app_restart():
    try: QProcess.startDetached(sys.executable, sys.argv); QApplication.quit()
    except Exception: pass

        self.split=QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Horizontal); self.split.setChildrenCollapsible(False); root.addWidget(self.split,1)
        self.panes={}; self.tabs={}

            hd=QHBoxLayout(); lab=QLabel(title); lab.setStyleSheet('font-weight:700;'); close=btn('×',24,bg='#fee2e2',h=22)

            self.split.addWidget(pane); self.panes[key]=pane; self.tabs[key]=tabs

        self.split.setSizes([1,1])
        if WEB:
            # Ask DELL / Copilot / Outlook系のSSO Cookieを可能な範囲で共有し、再認証要求を減らす。
            prof=configure_web_profile(QWebEngineProfile('BusinessSharedSSOProfile',self),'BusinessSharedSSOProfile')
            for key in ('ask','copilot'):
                self.profiles[key]=prof
        self.ask_btn.clicked.connect(lambda:self.set_pane_visible('ask',True)); self.copilot_btn.clicked.connect(lambda:self.set_pane_visible('copilot',True))
        self.reload.clicked.connect(lambda:[self.reload_current(k) for k in self.active_keys()])
        self.clear.clicked.connect(lambda:[self.inject_current(k,'',False) for k in self.active_keys()])
    def active_keys(self): return [k for k,v in self._active.items() if v]
    def set_pane_visible(self,key,visible):
        self._active[key]=bool(visible); self.panes[key].setVisible(visible)
        if not self.active_keys():
            other='copilot' if key=='ask' else 'ask'; self._active[other]=True; self.panes[other].setVisible(True)
        QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda:self.split.setSizes([1 if self._active.get('ask') else 0,1 if self._active.get('copilot') else 0]))
    def _url_for(self,key): return ASK if key=='ask' else COPILOT
    def _view(self,key,n):
        if WEB:
            v=QWebEngineView(); v.setPage(Page(self.profiles.get(key),None,v)); v.setZoomFactor(.8); v.setUrl(QUrl(self._url_for(key)))
            nid=n.get('id',''); self._ready[(key,nid)]=False; v.loadFinished.connect(lambda ok,k=key,id=nid:self.flush_pending(k,id) if ok else None)
            return v
        return QLabel('WebEngineなし')
    def slot(self,n): return n['fixed_index'] if is_fixed(n) else None
    def ensure_note(self,n):
        if not isinstance(n,dict): return
        nid=n['id']; self.notes=[x for x in self.notes if x.get('id')!=nid]+[n]
        s=self.slot(n)
        if s is not None: self.slot_id[s]=nid
        for key in ('ask','copilot'):
            tabs=self.tabs[key]
            if nid not in self.map[key]:
                v=self._view(key,n); self.map[key][nid]=v
                pos=s if s is not None and s<=tabs.count() else tabs.count(); tabs.insertTab(pos,v,ntitle(n))
            else:
                i=tabs.indexOf(self.map[key][nid])
                if i>=0: tabs.setTabText(i,ntitle(n))
    def switch_note(self,n):
        self.cur_note=n; self.ensure_note(n); nid=n.get('id')
        for key in ('ask','copilot'):
            v=self.map[key].get(nid); i=self.tabs[key].indexOf(v)
            if i>=0: self.tabs[key].setCurrentIndex(i)
    def delete_note(self,nid):
        for key in ('ask','copilot'):
            v=self.map[key].pop(nid,None)
            if v:
                i=self.tabs[key].indexOf(v)
                if i>=0: self.tabs[key].removeTab(i)
                v.deleteLater()
        for i,x in enumerate(self.slot_id):
            if x==nid: self.slot_id[i]=None
    def reset_fixed_slot(self,slot,old_id,new_note): self.delete_note(old_id); self.ensure_note(new_note)
    def bind_memo(self,memo):
        for n in memo.notes: self.ensure_note(n)
        if memo.notes: self.switch_note(memo.notes[memo.idx])
    def update_fixed_tag(self,i,tag):
        try:
            nid=self.slot_id[i]
            if not nid: return
            for n in self.notes:
                if n.get('id')==nid:
                    n['tag']=tag or ''; n['title']=FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i]
                    for key in ('ask','copilot'):
                        v=self.map[key].get(nid); idx=self.tabs[key].indexOf(v)
                        if idx>=0: self.tabs[key].setTabText(idx,ntitle(n))
                    break
        except Exception: pass
    def current_view(self,key):
        if self.cur_note: return self.map[key].get(self.cur_note.get('id'))
        return self.tabs[key].currentWidget()
    def reload_current(self,key):
        v=self.current_view(key)
        if WEB and hasattr(v,'setUrl'):
            nid=self.cur_note.get('id') if self.cur_note else ''; self._ready[(key,nid)]=False; v.setUrl(QUrl(self._url_for(key)))
    def send_to_note(self,n,text,enter=True):
        self.switch_note(n)
        for key in self.active_keys(): self.inject_current(key,text,enter)
    def flush_pending(self,key,nid):
        self._ready[(key,nid)]=True
        pending=[x for x in self._pending if x[0]==key and x[1]==nid]; self._pending=[x for x in self._pending if not (x[0]==key and x[1]==nid)]
        for _,_,txt,enter in pending: self.inject_current(key,txt,enter)
    def inject_current(self,key,text,enter=False):
        v=self.current_view(key); nid=self.cur_note.get('id') if self.cur_note else ''
        if not (WEB and hasattr(v,'page')):
            QApplication.clipboard().setText(text); return
        if not self._ready.get((key,nid),False):
            self._pending.append((key,nid,text,enter)); return
        js="""
(function(txt,submitNow){let areas=[...document.querySelectorAll('textarea, div[contenteditable="true"], [role="textbox"], input[type="text"]')];let el=areas.find(x=>x.offsetParent!==null)||areas[0];if(!el){try{navigator.clipboard.writeText(txt);}catch(e){} return 'clipboard';}el.focus();if(el.isContentEditable){el.textContent=txt; el.dispatchEvent(new InputEvent('input',{bubbles:true,inputType:'insertText',data:txt}));}else{el.value=txt; el.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); el.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));}if(submitNow){setTimeout(function(){let b=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role="button"]')].find(x=>!x.disabled && !/true/i.test(String(x.getAttribute('aria-disabled'))) && /send|送信|submit|arrow|paper/i.test((x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')+' '+(x.title||'')+' '+(x.innerText||''))); if(b)b.click();},250);} return 'ok';})(%s,%s);
"""%(json.dumps(text,ensure_ascii=False),'true' if enter else 'false')
        try: v.page().runJavaScript(js)
        except Exception: QApplication.clipboard().setText(text)
    def clear_input(self):
        for key in self.active_keys(): self.inject_current(key,'',False)


def parse_lkb_article_text(t):
    plain=strip_html(t or '')
    labels=['Knowledge Article','Article Record Type','Article Number','Publication Status','Validation Status','Last Modified Date','Version Number']
    compact=re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', plain).strip()
    def val(label):
        # 改行あり/なしどちらの貼り付けでも、次の項目名までを抽出する
        pat=r'(?is)'+re.escape(label)+r'\s*(.+?)(?=\s*(?:'+'|'.join(map(re.escape,[x for x in labels if x!=label]))+r')\s|$)'
        m=re.search(pat, compact)
        return m.group(1).strip() if m else ''
    title=val('Knowledge Article')
    num=val('Article Number') or regex_first(compact,[r'Article\s+Number\s*[:：#＃]?\s*(\d{6,})'])
    if title and num: return f'{title}\nLKB#{num}'
    return ''

class MemoCard(QWidget):
    raw_changed=Signal(str); clear_clicked=Signal(); selected=Signal()
    def __init__(self,n):
        super().__init__(); self.setFixedHeight(48); self._active=False; self._base_index=tag_color_index(n)%4; self._base_bg=TAG_TAB_COLORS[self._base_index]
        lay=QHBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(2,1,2,1); lay.setSpacing(2)
        self.input=QPlainTextEdit(); self.input.setFixedHeight(42); self.input.setPlainText(tag_display_text(n)); self.input.setPlaceholderText(ntitle(n)+'：TAG')
        self.input.setVerticalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff); self.input.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarPolicy.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.input.setFrameStyle(QFrame.Shape.NoFrame); self.input.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.IBeamCursor)
        self.x=QPushButton('×'); self.x.setFixedSize(16,16); self.x.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._x_style='font-size:7pt;padding:0;border:0px;background:transparent;color:#991b1b;font-weight:700;'
        self.x.setStyleSheet(self._x_style)
        lay.addWidget(self.input,1); lay.addWidget(self.x,0,Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self.x.clicked.connect(self.clear_clicked); self.input.textChanged.connect(lambda:self.raw_changed.emit(strip_html(self.input.toPlainText())))
        _orig_mouse_press=self.input.mousePressEvent
        def _select_then_edit(e,orig=_orig_mouse_press,s=self):
            s.selected.emit(); orig(e)
        self.input.mousePressEvent=_select_then_edit
        self.set_active(False)
    def set_active(self,active):
        self._active=bool(active)
        # 選択時もTAG①～④の元色は入力欄に保持し、カード背景だけ濃い青にする。
        card_bg=SELECTED_BLUE if self._active else self._base_bg
        card_border='#082f6f' if self._active else '#6b7280'
        self.setStyleSheet('MemoCard{background:%s;border:1px solid %s;border-radius:3px;color:#111827;}' % (card_bg,card_border))
        self.input.setStyleSheet('QPlainTextEdit{font-size:7pt;line-height:1.0;padding:1px;color:#111827;background:%s;border:0px;} QPlainTextEdit::selection{background:#1d4ed8;color:#ffffff;}' % self._base_bg)
        self.x.setStyleSheet(self._x_style)
    def mousePressEvent(self,e):
        self.selected.emit(); self.input.setFocus(); super().mousePressEvent(e)
    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self,e): self.selected.emit(); self.input.setFocus(); self.input.selectAll()

class NormalMemoCard(QWidget):
    delete_clicked=Signal(str); rename_requested=Signal(str); selected=Signal()
    def __init__(self,n):
        super().__init__(); self.setFixedHeight(24); self._active=False
        lay=QHBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(3,1,2,1); lay.setSpacing(2)
        self.label=QLabel(n.get('title') or 'メモ'); self.label.setStyleSheet('font-size:8pt;color:#111827;background:transparent;'); self.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor); self._nid=n.get('id','')
        self.x=QPushButton('×'); self.x.setFixedSize(16,16); self.x.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
        self._x_style='font-size:7pt;padding:0;border:0px;background:transparent;color:#991b1b;font-weight:700;'
        self.x.setStyleSheet(self._x_style)
        lay.addWidget(self.label,1); lay.addWidget(self.x,0,Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignTop)
        self.x.clicked.connect(lambda:self.delete_clicked.emit(n.get('id','')))
        self.set_active(False)
    def set_active(self,active):
        self._active=bool(active); bg=SELECTED_BLUE if active else '#ffffff'; border='#082f6f' if active else '#6b7280'
        self.setStyleSheet('NormalMemoCard{background:%s;border:1px solid %s;border-radius:3px;color:#111827;}' % (bg,border))
        self.label.setStyleSheet('font-size:8pt;color:#111827;background:transparent;')
        self.x.setStyleSheet(self._x_style)
    def mousePressEvent(self,e): self.selected.emit(); super().mousePressEvent(e)
    def mouseDoubleClickEvent(self,e): self.rename_requested.emit(self._nid); super().mouseDoubleClickEvent(e)

    def load(self):
        d=loadj(MEMO,{}); old=d.get('notes',[]) if isinstance(d,dict) else []; self.notes=[]
        for i,o in enumerate(old):
            if isinstance(o,dict):
                n=dict(o); n.setdefault('id',str(uuid.uuid4())); n.setdefault('title',n.get('name') or (FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i] if i<4 else f'メモ{i-3}')); n.setdefault('content',''); n.setdefault('raw',''); n.setdefault('tag',tag_of(n.get('raw',''))); n.setdefault('color',i%len(COLORS));
                if i<4: n['fixed_index']=i; n['title']=FIXED_TAG_TITLES[i]
                else: n.pop('fixed_index',None)
                self.notes.append(n)
        while len(self.notes)<4: self.notes.append(fixed_note(len(self.notes),{}))
        self.idx=max(0,min(int(d.get('idx',0) if isinstance(d,dict) else 0),len(self.notes)-1)); self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.apply()
    def save(self): self.sync(); savej(MEMO,{'notes':self.notes,'idx':self.idx}); self.saveMulti(); self.s['memo_window_split_sizes']=self.memoSplit.sizes() if hasattr(self,'memoSplit') else self.s.get('memo_window_split_sizes',[self.LEFT_W,520])
    def save_state(self,s): self.save(); s['memo_window_split_sizes']=self.s.get('memo_window_split_sizes',[self.LEFT_W,520])
    def saveMulti(self):
        if getattr(self,'_saving_multi',False): return
        self._saving_multi=True
        try: self.saveTemplateCurrent(); savej(self.multi_path,{'urlButtons':self.urlButtons,'tasks':self.tasks,'template_tabs':self.templateTabs,'templateCurrentTab':self.templateCurrentTab,'notepadCurrentTab':self.idx})
        finally: self._saving_multi=False
    def bind(self,ask,dell): self.ask=ask; self.dell=dell; ask.bind_memo(self) if ask else None; self.sync_all_tags_to_dell()
    def sync(self):
        if self.notes and 0<=self.idx<len(self.notes): self.notes[self.idx]['content']=strip_html(self.edit.toPlainText())
    def refresh(self):
        self._refreshing=True; self.list.clear()
        for i,n in enumerate(self.notes):
            it=QListWidgetItem(); it.setSizeHint(QSize(self.ITEM_W,self.ITEM_H if is_fixed(n) else 24)); self.list.addItem(it)
            c=MemoCard(n) if is_fixed(n) else NormalMemoCard(n)
            try: c.set_active(i==self.idx)
            except Exception: pass
            c.raw_changed.connect(lambda raw,nid=n['id']:self.related_changed(nid,raw)) if is_fixed(n) else (c.delete_clicked.connect(self.clear_or_delete), c.rename_requested.connect(self.rename_note))
            try: c.selected.connect(lambda i=i:self.select_left_card(i))
            except Exception: pass
            self.list.setItemWidget(it,c)
        self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self._refreshing=False; self.update_left_card_styles()
    def apply(self):
        if not self.notes: return
        n=self.notes[self.idx]; normal=self.idx>=4; self._note_loading=True; self.edit.blockSignals(True); self.edit.setPlainText(strip_html(n.get('content',''))); self.edit.blockSignals(False); self._note_loading=False; self.tag.setText(n.get('tag','') if not normal else ''); self.infoRow.setVisible(not normal); self.mx.setVisible(not normal); self.update_outputs(); self.ask.switch_note(n) if self.ask else None
    def select_left_card(self,row):
        if row<0 or row>=len(self.notes): return
        if self.list.currentRow()!=row: self.list.setCurrentRow(row)
        if self.idx!=row: self.change(row)
        else: self.update_left_card_styles()
    def update_left_card_styles(self):
        try:
            for r in range(self.list.count()):
                w=self.list.itemWidget(self.list.item(r))
                if hasattr(w,'set_active'): w.set_active(r==self.idx)
        except Exception: pass
    def change(self,row):
        if self._refreshing or row<0 or row>=len(self.notes): return
        self.sync(); self.idx=row; self.apply(); self.update_left_card_styles(); self.save(); self.renderSearchResults()
    def body_changed(self):
        if self._note_loading: return
        self.sync(); self.update_outputs(); self.save()
    def rename_note(self,nid):
        row=next((i for i,n in enumerate(self.notes) if n.get('id')==nid),-1)
        if row<4: return
        cur=self.notes[row].get('title') or 'メモ'
        name,ok=QInputDialog.getText(self,APP,'メモ帳名の変更',text=cur)
        if ok and name.strip():
            self.notes[row]['title']=name.strip(); self.refresh(); self.save(); self.ask.ensure_note(self.notes[row]) if self.ask else None
    def add_note(self):
        self.sync(); i=1; names=[n.get('title','') for n in self.notes]
        while f'メモ{i}' in names: i+=1
        self.notes.append({'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'title':f'メモ{i}','content':'','raw':'','tag':'','color':len(self.notes)%len(COLORS)}); self.idx=len(self.notes)-1; self.refresh(); self.list.setCurrentRow(self.idx); self.apply(); self.save()
    def clear_body(self): self.edit.clear(); self.sync(); self.update_outputs(); self.save()
    def clear_or_delete(self,nid):
        row=next((i for i,n in enumerate(self.notes) if n.get('id')==nid),-1)
        if row<0: return
        was_current=(row==self.idx)
        n=self.notes[row]
        fixed=is_fixed(n)
        if fixed:
            box=QMessageBox(QMessageBox.Icon.Question,APP,'情報をクリアしてよいですか？',QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes|QMessageBox.StandardButton.No,self)
            try:
                box.button(QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes).setText('はい')
                box.button(QMessageBox.StandardButton.No).setText('いいえ')
            except Exception: pass
            try:

        for c in cats:

    def sync_tag_to_dell(self,i,tag):
        tag=tag_of(tag or '') or (tag or '').strip()
        if i<0 or i>3: return
        try:
            for w in QApplication.topLevelWidgets()+QApplication.allWidgets():
                try:
                    if hasattr(w,'update_fixed_tag'): w.update_fixed_tag(i,tag)
                    if hasattr(w,'set_tag_for_group'): w.set_tag_for_group(i,tag)
                    elif hasattr(w,'tag_boxes') and 0<=i<len(w.tag_boxes):
                        if w.tag_boxes[i].text()!=tag: w.tag_boxes[i].setText(tag or '')
                except Exception: pass
        except Exception: pass

        it=self.plist.currentItem() or self.plist.item(0); return it.text() if it else '🔎 汎用分析'
    def to_ask(self,send=True):
        raw=self.edit.toPlainText(); tag=self.notes[self.idx].get('tag','') if self.notes and self.idx<4 else ''; txt=build_prompt(self.current_prompt(),raw,self.prompts,tag)
        delivered=False
        if self.ask:
            try:
                if hasattr(self.ask,'switch_note') and self.notes: self.ask.switch_note(self.notes[self.idx])
                if hasattr(self.ask,'active_keys'):
                    for key in self.ask.active_keys(): self.ask.inject_current(key,txt,send)
                    delivered=True
                elif hasattr(self.ask,'inject_current'):
                    try: self.ask.inject_current(self.notes[self.idx],txt,send); delivered=True
                    except TypeError: self.ask.inject_current(txt,send); delivered=True
            except Exception: pass
        if not delivered: QApplication.clipboard().setText(txt)

class OneNoteLaunchOnlyTab(QWidget):
    def __init__(self,parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        lay=QVBoxLayout(self); lay.setContentsMargins(12,12,12,12)
        self.open_btn=btn('OneNoteを起動',140,bg='#dbeafe')
        lay.addWidget(self.open_btn,0,Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft); lay.addStretch()
        self.open_btn.clicked.connect(self.launch)
    def launch(self):
        candidates=[
            lambda: QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl('onenote:')),
            lambda: QDesktopServices.openUrl(QUrl('onenote-cmd:')),
            lambda: QProcess.startDetached('onenote.exe', []),
            lambda: QProcess.startDetached('ONENOTE.EXE', []),
            lambda: QProcess.startDetached('cmd.exe', ['/c','start','','onenote:']),
            lambda: subprocess.Popen(['explorer.exe','shell:AppsFolder\\Microsoft.Office.OneNote_8wekyb3d8bbwe!microsoft.onenoteim'], shell=False) or True,
            lambda: webbrowser.open('onenote:')
        ]
        for f in candidates:
            try:
                r=f()
                if r: return
            except Exception: pass
        QMessageBox.warning(self, APP, 'OneNoteを起動できませんでした。')
    def launch_onenote(self): self.launch()

class LazyToolTab(QWidget):
    def __init__(self,title,clsname,parent_tools=None):
        super().__init__(parent_tools); self.title=title; self.clsname=clsname; self.parent_tools=parent_tools; self.loaded=False; self.real=None
        self._lay=QVBoxLayout(self); self._lay.setContentsMargins(12,12,12,12); self._label=QLabel(f'{title} はタブ選択時に読み込みます。'); self._label.setWordWrap(True); self._lay.addWidget(self._label); self._lay.addStretch()
    def load(self):
        if self.loaded: return self.real
        self.loaded=True
        try:
            cls=eclass(self.clsname); w=cls(self) if self.clsname not in ('ImageCompareTab','BrowserTab','MemoTab') else cls()
            if hasattr(w,'ensure_initialized'): QTimer.singleShot(250,w.ensure_initialized)
        except Exception as e: w=etab(self.title,e)
        while self._lay.count():
            it=self._lay.takeAt(0); old=it.widget(); old.deleteLater() if old else None
        self._lay.setContentsMargins(0,0,0,0); self._lay.addWidget(w); self.real=w; return w
